name: WeblyAgent Connect
author: weblyarts

sections.description:
WeblyAgent Connect allows you to deploy an AI assistant on your WordPress website through an elegant visitor chat widget.

Instead of providing generic answers, the assistant can respond using your business knowledge, documentation, FAQs, products, services and website content managed through WeblySuite.

Whether you run a company website, an e-commerce store, a customer support portal or a documentation hub, WeblyAgent Connect helps visitors find information instantly, 24/7.

What you can do

  • Answer visitor questions automatically
  • Provide product and service information
  • Assist customers before they contact support
  • Reduce repetitive support requests
  • Deliver answers based on your company knowledge
  • Offer multilingual conversations
  • Create a more engaging website experience

Powered by WeblySuite

WeblyAgent Connect works together with WeblySuite cloud services.

The plugin acts as the WordPress client while AI processing, knowledge retrieval and agent execution are handled by WeblySuite infrastructure.

A WeblySuite account is required.

Requirements

Before using WeblyAgent Connect you must install:

  • WeblyConnect (required)
  • An active WeblySuite account

WeblyConnect handles the secure connection between your WordPress site and your WeblySuite workspace.

WeblySuite ecosystem

WeblyAgent Connect is part of the WeblySuite ecosystem for WordPress.

Available plugins:

  • WeblyConnect (required)
  • WeblyAgent Connect
  • WeblyMCP Connect (coming soon)

Together they allow WordPress sites to connect with AI agents, knowledge bases, automations and external business tools.

sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WeblyConnect.
  2. Install and activate WeblyAgent Connect.
  3. Connect your WordPress site to WeblySuite using a valid WeblyToken.
  4. Configure your visitor assistant.
  5. Publish the chat widget on your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need a WeblySuite account?

Yes.

WeblyAgent Connect relies on WeblySuite cloud services for AI processing, knowledge retrieval and conversation management.

Does it work without WeblyConnect?

No.

WeblyConnect is required to establish the secure connection between WordPress and WeblySuite.

Can I train the assistant on my company content?

Yes.

Knowledge sources and AI behavior are managed through your WeblySuite workspace.

Does the plugin generate AI responses locally?

No.

Responses are generated by WeblySuite cloud services and streamed back to the WordPress chat widget.

Is WeblyMCP Connect required?

No.

WeblyAgent Connect works independently.

WeblyMCP Connect provides additional integrations and automation capabilities and will be available separately.
